purpose.en: Choose costly noisy observations and contingent allocations with a certified worst-case expected payoff interval.
purpose.fr: Choisir des observations bruitées à coût explicite et des allocations conditionnelles avec un intervalle certifié du gain espéré garanti.

input.scenarios: nonempty array of unique IDs, nonnegative integer column budgets and nonnegative integer weights on common lanes
input.instruments: nonempty array of unique IDs with costs and scenario-indexed channel rows
input.cost_units: same payoff units as lane weights
input.channel: exact nonnegative rational strings or integers, with one common signal alphabet per instrument and every row summing exactly to one
preconditions: Finite one-shot zero-sum allocation with additive signed lane payoffs.
The opponent observes the declared policy and chooses its scenario and allocation before learning the selected instrument or observed signal.
The row player can privately draw and pay for one instrument and condition its allocation on that signal.
Channel distributions, payoff units, feasible budgets and acquisition costs are supplied by the caller.
input.alternative: Use separately announced-instrument comparisons when the opponent observes selection before acting.

output.description: Source-bound feasible instrument masses, signal-conditional allocation policies, opponent scenario-allocation mixture and exact rational best-response bounds.
output.acceptance: QUALIFIED requires exact gap at most one part per million of the largest scenario weight total with a floor of one. A wider valid interval gives BOUND_ONLY.

authority.evaluator_custody: independently authored cases and executable checks in a shared administrative workspace

execution.scope_characteristic: Pseudo-polynomial in numeric budgets and proportional to instrument-signal branches.

precision_limitation: Candidate probabilities are constructed with HiGHS numerical arithmetic and integer rounding. Exact intervals decide acceptance on the declared payoff scale.

qualification.retention: Exact source files, artifact, certificates, declared game scope and acceptance evidence.
qualification.requalification: Solve and check new instances. A changed model hash invalidates old certificates. New information timing, payoff structure or software source requires its own qualification.
